sources.search_query: Czechia foreign ministry tourist visa short stay Schengen official
sources.relevant_excerpt: The visa is intended for third country nationals who wish to stay in the Czech Republic on a short-term basis. A short-term stay is a stay lasting a maximum of 90 days. Applications can be submitted only at one of the Czech Republic's diplomatic missions. [Site: Official Information Portal for Foreigners of the Ministry of the Interior of the Czech Republic. Footer: (c)2026 Ministry of the interior of the Czech republic.]

sources.search_query: Czechia foreign ministry tourist visa short stay Schengen official
sources.relevant_excerpt: You can temporarily stay without a visa in the Schengen Area for 90 days in any 180-day long period. Stays cannot be extended; you must leave after 90 days. Eligible: citizens of visa-waived countries, EU citizens, holders of EU residence permits or residence cards, family members of EU citizens. Register with Foreign Police within 3 days of arrival. Stay is for non-profit purposes only - no employment or business activity. Bilateral agreements: Argentina, Chile, Israel, South Korea, Costa Rica, Malaysia, and Uruguay: additional 90 days permitted. Singapore: 30 additional days. These bilateral stays apply only within the Czech Republic - no travel to other EU/Schengen states.

sources.search_query: mzv.gov.cz Schengen visa fee EUR administrative fee short-term visa Czech Republic
sources.relevant_excerpt: Schengen short-term visa (Type C, A): adults EUR 90; children 6-11 EUR 45; children under 6 free of charge. Facilitation rate of EUR 35 for Schengen visas for Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, Ukraine (Ukraine also EUR 70 for express processing). Exempt from visa fees: children younger than 6 years of age, students and teachers traveling for educational purposes, researchers conducting scientific research, family members of citizens of the EU. Visa fees are collected in cash, by card or bank transfer in EUR or in the local currency or in other currency (such as in USD), based on the exchange rate. Visa fee is not refunded in case of visa refusal.

sources.search_query: ipc.gov.cz OR mzv.gov.cz Czech Republic entry conditions travel document validity 3 months 10 years
sources.relevant_excerpt: You hold a valid travel document which is valid for at least 3 months after the intended departure date from the Schengen Area and, at the same time, it was issued in the previous 10 years. You hold a valid short-term visa, if you are required to have a visa, or a valid long-term visa or a valid residence permit. You must justify the purpose and conditions of the intended stay and have sufficient funds for the duration of the intended stay as well as for the return. You must not be registered in the Schengen Information System (SIS) as a person that should be denied entry and must not be considered a threat to the peace, State security, public health or international relations.

sources.search_query: mzv.gov.cz Schengen visa fee EUR administrative fee short-term visa Czech Republic
sources.relevant_excerpt: Applications are filed at consulates or visa centers located in applicants' consular districts, commonly in person, not at a border crossing nor in CZE. File in your country of citizenship or residence; if unavailable locally, apply at a facility in your consular district, often in a neighbouring state. Some other Schengen countries represent the Czech Republic in visa issuance. For multi-country travel, apply with the state that is the only or the main destination or where you will stay longest.

policies.policy_name: List of States Whose Citizens Are Exempt from Visa Requirement (Schengen short-stay)
policies.description: Czech MFA list of states and territories whose citizens may enter the Czech Republic (Schengen Area) visa-free for short-term non-profit stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Includes conditional exemptions: biometric passports required for Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Kosovo, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and Ukraine; Taiwan passports must contain an identity card number; Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passports only; five categories of British nationals also exempt.
conditions: Short-term non-profit stays only; employment requires a Schengen visa for employment

policies.policy_name: Schengen short-term visa (Type C) for tourism
